title: What LLMs Actually Are
description: Build an accurate mental model of how large language models work before you write a single prompt in anger.
learningOutcomes: Explain next-token prediction well enough to predict model behavior
Call a real LLM API from Python and handle its parameters deliberately
Write prompts that behave consistently instead of accidentally
Recognize hallucination, context limits, and cost as design constraints, not surprises

lessons.title: How LLMs Predict Text
lessons.description: Tokens, next-token prediction, and why a language model is a very sophisticated autocomplete.
learningObjectives: Explain what a token is and why models don't see words
Explain next-token prediction as the entire generation mechanism
Explain what training data does and doesn't guarantee about correctness

lessons.title: Calling an LLM From Python
lessons.description: Send a real chat completion request from Python and understand every parameter you set.
learningObjectives: Send a chat completion request with the messages format
Control output with temperature, max tokens, and stop sequences
Stream a response instead of waiting for the whole thing

lessons.title: Prompting That Actually Works
lessons.description: Write prompts that behave the same way on the tenth run as they did on the first.
learningObjectives: Separate instructions from data in a prompt
Ask for a specific output shape instead of hoping for one
Diagnose why a prompt is producing inconsistent results

lessons.title: Where LLMs Break
lessons.description: Hallucination, context limits, non-determinism, and cost: the constraints every Gen AI feature has to design around.
learningObjectives: Explain why hallucination is expected behavior, not a bug
Reason about context window limits before hitting them in production
Estimate the cost and latency of a feature before building it

assignment.title: Assignment: A Research Brief Generator
assignment.description: Build a small CLI that turns one topic into a validated, multi-question research brief — the whole module working together as one real tool.
learningObjectives: Wire multiple chained LLM calls into one small Python CLI
Validate every piece of model output against a schema before trusting it
Handle partial failure gracefully instead of aborting the whole run
Estimate and report the real cost of a multi-call feature
